# Flossie Tulk

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c26 P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019)</sub>
- **Role:** student  <sub>[v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Flossie is described as having a heavier build rather than a slim frame. She possesses a distinct appearance that others contrast with red hair, though her exact hair color is not detailed. She is also noted as someone who will resemble her cousin Aunt Drusilla when she reaches adulthood.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v3 c11 P41](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0041)_

## Personality

Flossie is bold, haughty, and caustic-tongued, often making unpleasant and bitter remarks about others. She is moody and superstitious, harboring malice toward her peers and taking pleasure in their humiliation or failures. Lacking a creative mind, she exhibits little restraint or tact, yet she possesses a natural confidence that leads her to speak up and act without hesitation.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 c32 P7](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0007), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v3 c11 P41](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0041)_

## History

Flossie attended school in Brierley, where she gained a reputation for her skill in walking wooden fences and her skill at knitted lace, for which she won top prize at an exhibition. She frequently challenged and targeted Nell Harcourt, once daring her onto a ridgepole that resulted in Nell injuring her ankle. Flossie was disappointed when she was refused the role of the fairy queen in a school dialogue due to her heavier weight, causing her to become moody during rehearsals. She was also involved in local petty feuds, including a three-month silence with Julia Bell after Flossie made a derogatory comment about her recitation bow. Joining the Regent's class, she struggled with arithmetic but successfully passed the entrance exams with a three-point margin. She went on to attend Regent's Academy, residing at a lodging where she befriended Frank Stockley. At the Academy, she earned a distinction among students for being the most caustic-tongued young woman. Later, when Nell published a prize-winning story in island newspapers, Flossie disdainfully accused her of plagiarizing it from an older publication. She also engaged in eavesdropping on telephone calls made to her household alongside her sister Tibby.
